I'm checking whether the codemod's down('sm') to down('md') swap preserves behavior, since v5's down() is exclusive of the upper bound. In v4, down('sm') covered widths under 960px, but in v5 md starts at 900px, so down('md') means under 900px and would not match. Testing at 920px should show the difference, because 920 is compact in v4 but not under 900 in v5.

I'm weighing whether a numeric argument fixes the breakpoint mismatch, since the app's breakpoints may not be set in the theme. Using theme.breakpoints.down(960) would keep the v4 cutoff in v5 and match the comment's "below 960px."
